summary: Filler intermittent F17 low pilot-air alarm during start-up
findings_text: Plant header seen at 6.4 bar on wall gauge. Local regulator not checked because guard key unavailable. Cleared alarm and restarted.
follow_up_text: Check PP-4101 regulator at next stop.

summary: Product pump rattling near coupling guard
findings_text: Coupling guard removed. Red spider shows edge dust but no missing lugs. Pump run at 42 Hz sounded acceptable.
follow_up_text: Add vibration route point to weekly check.

summary: Reject diverter slow to return after sanitation
findings_text: Cylinder returns after 620 ms on manual test. Oiled guide rods and cycled ten times; final stroke 420 ms. No pressure reading taken at FRL outlet.
follow_up_text: Replace muffler if slow return repeats.

summary: Temperature controller hunting at filler inlet
findings_text: Product side differential pressure read from panel as 0.68 bar at 16.2 m3/h. Near clean-in-place review value but not over 0.70 bar.
follow_up_text: Trend PHE differential after weekly clean.

summary: High vibration and intermittent seal drip at product transfer pump
findings_text: Guard dust heavy. Spider changed. Seal drip reduced but still wet after 8 min at 49 Hz. No alignment check done because filler restart was requested.
follow_up_text: Create follow-up for laser alignment and seal inspection.

summary: F17 low pilot-air alarm stops filler on first start
findings_text: Asset selected from old import. Actual machine is RF-4101. Header gauge 6.5 bar. No drain from FRL bowl recorded. Restarted after speed reduced to 190 bottles/min.
follow_up_text: Verify local regulator outlet during running fault, not static.

summary: Temporary product flow loss at filler inlet
findings_text: Strainer opened. Basket had label fragments and pulp film. Cleaned and returned. No suction gauge fitted, so differential pressure not measured. Flow improved from 14.1 to 16.4 m3/h at 48 Hz.
follow_up_text: Fit temporary suction gauge if noise returns.

summary: Drain local regulator bowl after water seen in lower sight glass
findings_text: Approx 35 ml water and white debris drained from bowl. Outlet pressure set by memory to 5.4 bar; no calibrated gauge used.
follow_up_text: Order filter element and fit at next planned stop.

summary: Filler stopped after reject gate failed to clear
findings_text: Operator reported plant air okay. Manual cycle of DV-4103 sluggish. Restart after two purge cycles. No part changed.
follow_up_text: Compare event to local pressure trend from PP-4101.

summary: Fit temporary suction pressure gauge at product pump strainer outlet
parts_claimed: 1 x glycerine gauge WIKA-0126-44; 1 x tri-clamp adaptor
findings_text: Gauge fitted downstream of ST-4102. Baseline at 48 Hz after start: -0.18 bar. Marked gauge with date and route note.
follow_up_text: Remove after diagnosis or replace with permanent differential pressure instrument.

summary: Pump DE bearing housing hot during production
findings_text: Handheld infrared at guard window read 62 C. Historian display showed filler bearing 81 C but location not verified. No action taken.
follow_up_text: Reliability to confirm TT-4102-DE tag mapping.

summary: Reject/diverter valve slow return and intermittent false reject count
findings_text: Mufflers replaced. Stroke still 510 ms at 5.0 bar local reading, but 350 ms at 5.7 bar when regulator bypassed for test.
follow_up_text: FRL filter element or regulator seat suspected.

summary: Replace pump mechanical seal due product drip
parts_claimed: seal kit SK-65-160-CARB-SIC listed in close-out
findings_text: Close-out text says seal replaced and drip stopped. Technician initials absent on completion tab. Permit close time 09:15 conflicts with recorded closure at 15:55.
follow_up_text: Verify physical seal condition and inventory issue before accepting as completed.

summary: Stage pump seal kit and isolate pump for repair
findings_text: Comment states kit staged on bench but not installed because production restart overrode job. Cancelled because WO-57291 was open.
follow_up_text: Do not use this cancelled status as proof the seal was fitted.

summary: Wet floor under pump guard at start of early shift
findings_text: Small drip visible at seal flush groove. Wiped clean and restarted at 46 Hz to get line running.
follow_up_text: Seal replacement not evident from visual condition.

summary: Laser alignment after motor shift mark found on base
findings_text: Final report attached. CMMS close-out says within tolerance. Report body shows 0.12 mm horizontal offset and -0.09 mm/100 mm angular at coupling.
follow_up_text: Compare report to OEM pump tolerance before accepting pass.

summary: F17 and reject gate fault during night run
findings_text: Header trend remained above 6.2 bar. Local FRL outlet not stable, seen bouncing between 4.5 and 5.1 bar when filler valve bank cycled. Bowl showed water line.
follow_up_text: Replace FRL element and verify outlet under dynamic load.

summary: Pump flow under target at normal filler demand
findings_text: Flow at 48 Hz only 13.8 m3/h with suction gauge -0.42 bar. Strainer not opened due allergen changeover lockout. Cavitation-like gravel noise heard.
follow_up_text: Open ST-4102 and inspect suction hose before replacing pump.

summary: Check plate heat exchanger differential pressure after reduced transfer rate
findings_text: Product side differential 0.72 bar at 15.0 m3/h before clean, 0.49 bar at 16.8 m3/h after mini-CIP. Does not remove pump suction vacuum.
follow_up_text: PHE fouling was a contributor to rate loss but not seal drip or vibration.

summary: Replace local FRL element for filler pilot air
findings_text: Element dark and swollen. Bowl drained 60 ml water. Outlet reset to 5.6 bar using calibrated gauge. Stroke time 330 to 350 ms over 20 cycles.
follow_up_text: Keep daily bowl drain until water source traced.

summary: Inspect pump suction strainer after repeat vacuum reading
findings_text: Basket 60 percent blinded with label backing and citrus pulp film. After clean, suction improved from -0.45 to -0.20 bar and flow from 13.9 to 16.7 m3/h at 48 Hz.
follow_up_text: Review upstream label rinse and add strainer inspection after citrus SKU.

summary: Reliability review of pump vibration after strainer clean
findings_text: Vibration improved slightly but P-4102 DE horizontal remained 7.8 mm/s RMS at 49 Hz with dominant 1x and high axial. Seal still misting.
follow_up_text: Re-align to OEM tolerance and plan confirmed seal replacement.

summary: Filler start-up after FRL element replacement
findings_text: No F17 alarm during 90 minute run. Local outlet 5.5 to 5.7 bar at 210 bottles/min.
follow_up_text: Pneumatic fault considered controlled; continue monitoring water carryover.

summary: Planner note to replace pump if vibration remains high
findings_text: P-4102B is wrong asset code. No inspection was performed under this order.
follow_up_text: Correct asset code and base decision on alignment, seal and bearing checks.
